new-129.zh-Hans: 人设女性：年轻漂亮，长发披肩，坐在出租车后排。角色状态：与男友分手告别，表面强撑微笑、内心悲伤压抑，最终情绪崩溃嚎啕大哭。场景出租车内部的后排车厢作为空间环境参考，前排副驾驶空位（前景局部失焦虚化）；侧车窗与后车窗均被雨水打湿；车窗外为城市街道夜景、霓虹灯光、淅淅沥沥的小雨。画面风格真人实拍质感的青春恋爱电视剧，现代都市写实服化道，细腻情感戏审美，情绪戏节奏克制。影调车内整体偏暗，窗外城市夜景与霓虹灯光透过雨打车窗，在车内形成流动的彩色光斑与明暗切片，勾勒女性面部轮廓与长发边缘；车窗玻璃上雨珠反光；夜景冷调为主，霓虹光斑冷暖交织。全局约束无字幕、禁止生成字幕。画面内容分镜 1，0s-6s，车内中景，固定机位，摄像机位于前排副驾驶位置朝后方拍摄；前景左下方为副驾驶空座椅背局部（失焦虚化），女性位于画面右侧三分线位置。她侧着脸望向右侧车窗外，轻咬下唇，微笑着与窗外人道别，窗外站着一名身穿灰色夹克黑色牛仔裤的男性，透过车窗只能看见男性的局部身体：对白：女性（轻咬下唇，微笑）：「就这样，不用送了。」随后她转头面向镜头，对前排司机说：对白：女性：「司机，开车。」说完她不经意地带出一声压抑的细微啜泣，随即轻轻舒了一口气，脸上仍保持着刚才的微笑。出租车随即启动，车身轻微震动一下，车辆起步向前开动，窗外男性朝着车窗挥手再见（局部入画），男性与窗外雨幕与霓虹灯光快速向后掠过。音效：淅沥雨声打在车顶与车窗，城市夜晚低缓的环境底噪；对白期间人声清晰突出；一声压抑的细微啜泣；轻舒气声；发动机启动声与车身轻微震动；轮胎碾过湿路面的起步声。分镜 2，6s-15s，切换车内后排近景，手持拍摄，轻微仰拍，镜头随行驶中的车身轻微晃动；焦点在女性肩部以上正面，她背后隔着被雨打湿而模糊的后车窗，城市街景与霓虹灯光逐渐远去。一开始女性脸上仍带着微笑，没有皱眉也没有哭，慢慢地她开始轻微皱起眉头，小幅摇了摇头，像是反悔刚才说出口的话；接着她的嘴角微微下压，抿紧双唇，眼眶开始泛红；她稍稍仰起头试图忍住，眼神有些游离地瞥向旁边车窗外；接着她终于再也压抑不住 —— 嘴角明显下垂，眉毛内收收紧，鼻子开始抽搐，眼神黯淡，眼眶湿润，泪水开始流出；然后她垂下头、微微蜷缩着肩膀，随即猛然仰头，嚎啕大哭，一边哭一边抬手擦去脸上止不住的泪水。整段为逞强微笑→压抑情绪→悲伤外泄→情绪大爆发的连续情绪变化，一镜到底。音效：雨声持续；行驶中发动机低鸣与轮胎碾过湿路面的沙沙声；呼吸渐重、吸鼻声；压抑啜泣转为放声大哭；手背擦拭泪水的摩擦声与衣料声。全局配乐雨夜分手情绪戏（15s 配乐轨，无歌词）0-6s 无BGM，只保留对白和环境声；6-8s 微笑→轻微皱眉 | 钢琴单音/两音动机从雨声里渗出，极弱 pad 垫底，像回忆浮上来；8-10s 摇头反悔→抿唇→眼眶泛红 | 钢琴变叹息式下行音型，大提琴长音进入；10-12s 仰头忍泪→眼神游离 | 小提琴组加入，和声加厚，钢琴分解和弦铺开；12-13.5s 嘴角下压→鼻翼抽动→泪落 | 情绪临界：弦乐揉弦+力度加强，钢琴和弦加重；13.5-15s 垂头蜷缩→仰头嚎啕大哭 | 段落峰值：弦乐齐奏主题，钢琴八度重音。
new-129.en: Character design female: young and beautiful, long hair draped over her shoulders, sitting in the back seat of a taxi. Character state: breaking up and saying goodbye to her boyfriend, forcing a smile on the surface while sad and suppressed inside, ultimately her emotions collapse into loud sobbing. Scene: the rear cabin inside the taxi serves as the spatial environment reference, the front passenger seat is empty (foreground partial out-of-focus blur); both the side window and the rear window are wet with rain; outside the windows are the city street night scene, neon lights, and a pattering light rain. Visual style: live-action texture youth romance TV drama, modern urban realistic costumes, makeup, props, and styling, delicate emotional drama aesthetics, restrained emotional scene rhythm. Tone: the interior of the car is overall dark, the city night scene and neon lights outside the window pass through the rain-streaked car window, forming flowing colored light spots and slices of light and shadow inside the car, outlining the female's facial contours and the edges of her long hair; raindrops reflect on the car window glass; the night scene is mainly cool-toned, with neon light spots interweaving cold and warm. Global constraint: no subtitles, subtitle generation prohibited. Visual content storyboard 1, 0s-6s, interior medium shot, fixed camera, the camera is located at the front passenger seat position shooting toward the rear; the lower left foreground is a partial view of the empty front passenger seat back (out-of-focus blur), the female is located at the right third line of the frame. She turns her face sideways looking out the right car window, lightly biting her lower lip, smiling as she says goodbye to the person outside the window; outside the window stands a male wearing a gray jacket and black jeans, through the car window only part of the male's body can be seen: Dialogue: Female (lightly biting her lower lip, smiling): "That's it, no need to see me off." (That's it, no need to see me off.) Then she turns her head to face the camera and says to the driver in the front row: Dialogue: Female: "Driver, drive." (Driver, drive.) After saying this she inadvertently lets out a suppressed tiny sob, then gently lets out a breath, still keeping the smile from before on her face. The taxi then starts, the car body shakes slightly once, the vehicle starts and moves forward, the male outside the window waves goodbye toward the car window (partially entering the frame), the male and the rain curtain and neon lights outside the window quickly sweep backward. Sound effects: pattering rain hitting the roof and car windows, low ambient noise of the city at night; during dialogue the human voice is clear and prominent; a suppressed tiny sob; a light breath sound; engine start sound and slight car body vibration; the starting sound of tires rolling over the wet road. Storyboard 2, 6s-15s, cut to an interior rear-seat close-up, handheld shooting, slight low angle, the camera shakes slightly with the moving car body; focus is on the female above the shoulders frontal view, behind her is the rain-wet and blurred rear car window, the city street scene and neon lights gradually recede. At first the female still has a smile on her face, no frowning and no crying; slowly she begins to frown slightly, shakes her head slightly, as if regretting what she just said; then the corners of her mouth press down slightly, she purses her lips tightly, her eye rims begin to redden; she tilts her head up slightly trying to hold it back, her gaze drifting somewhat as she glances toward the car window beside her; then she finally can no longer suppress it — the corners of her mouth clearly droop, her brows draw inward and tighten, her nose begins to twitch, her gaze dims, her eye rims become moist, tears begin to flow out; then she lowers her head, slightly curls her shoulders, and then suddenly throws her head up, wailing loudly, while crying she raises her hand to wipe the unstoppable tears from her face. The entire segment is a continuous emotional change from forcing a smile → suppressing emotions → sadness leaking out → emotional outburst, one continuous take. Sound effects: rain sound continues; during driving the low hum of the engine and the rustling sound of tires rolling over the wet road; breathing gradually heavier, sniffling sounds; suppressed sobbing turns into loud crying; the friction sound of the back of the hand wiping tears and clothing sounds. Global soundtrack: rainy night breakup emotional scene (15s soundtrack track, no lyrics) 0-6s no BGM, only dialogue and ambient sound retained; 6-8s smile → slight frown | piano single note/two-note motif seeps out from the rain sound, extremely weak pad underneath, like memories floating up; 8-10s shaking head in regret → pursing lips → eye rims reddening | piano turns into sighing descending figure, cello long note enters; 10-12s tilting head up to hold back tears → gaze drifting | violin section joins, harmony thickens, piano arpeggios spread out; 12-13.5s corners of mouth pressing down → nose wings twitching → tears falling | emotional threshold: string vibrato + increased intensity, piano chords heavier; 13.5-15s lowering head and curling up → throwing head up and wailing loudly | segment peak: string unison theme, piano octave accents.
